summary: Give employees practical AI literacy skills in prompts, output checks, and data safety. Explore scalable, scenario-based e-learning for your workforce.
lede: Workplace AI literacy helps employees use generative AI tools with sound judgment in everyday tasks. This foundational course is for non-technical staff and managers who use, evaluate, procure, or oversee AI-assisted tools, and covers selecting suitable tasks, drafting prompts, and checking outputs for accuracy. Learners also practise classifying data before use, recognizing privacy risks, and escalating concerns through workplace scenarios.
audienceIntro: This foundational AI literacy course is for employees who use, evaluate, procure, or oversee AI-assisted tools in everyday work. It suits non-technical staff as well as managers responsible for setting workplace expectations. This course is designed for: Administrative officers who draft correspondence with AI-assisted tools. HR coordinators who handle employee information and AI-supported content. Finance analysts who review AI-generated summaries of financial material. Communications specialists who verify AI-drafted public-facing content. Procurement officers who assess AI tool claims and supplier information. Operations coordinators who identify suitable AI-assisted workflow tasks. Data protection staff who advise on sensitive information entered into AI tools. Information security analysts who assess shadow AI exposure and data risks. AI governance coordinators who communicate approved-use rules across teams. Department heads who set expectations for responsible employee use of AI.
modules: Generative AI Prompt Design and Review
AI Data Privacy and Shadow AI
NIST AI RMF and Responsible Use
prerequisites: No technical background is required. Familiarity with everyday workplace digital tools is helpful; learners should follow their organization’s current data-handling and AI-use policies during scenario activities.
